normal_policy: Split opposing smoothed corners into the geometric face hemisphere before final tangent generation. Retain source float precision only where the 0.1mm compression grid would create a degenerate cap triangle. No authored shape, UV, winding or triangle-count change.
lod_method: Regenerate coherent primitives at lower angular tessellation; keep boxes/curves and interface dimensions, omit separate tiny shell rivet heads. No arbitrary global decimation.
limitations: Studio importer/upload is unverified; asset IDs intentionally absent.
No measured Roblox client/server frame-time benchmark.
Detail count still substantial; local distance/deck culling supplied, not a performance guarantee.
Transparent glass uses standard alpha PBR, not Blender transmission.
